resources.string: The app will appear and launch as a local gallery. You will choose one local photo and a hidden three-tap sequence to open the main screen.
Add photos if needed, then choose the photo that will contain the hidden three-tap access sequence.
Gallery mode could not be enabled. Nothing was changed.
Gallery storage could not be read or updated.
Tap three different zones in the order you want to use: four corners and the center. A zone cannot be repeated.
Repeat the same three-zone sequence to confirm it.
The sequences do not match. Enter the confirmation sequence again.
Only the private Gallery copy will be deleted. The original selected through the system photo picker is not changed.
Reset Gallery disguise and restore the normal app launcher? Local Gallery photos, favorites and metadata will be kept.
